title: Machine comparison
description: Which machines or configs save the most?

panels.title: Net saved by machine (USD, selected range)

targets.expr: sort_desc((((sum by (machine)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (machine)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0) - ((sum by (machine)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (machine)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0)))

panels.title: By preset
panels.description: Saving rate is net saved divided by spend plus net saved (the exact baseline counter is not built). Net per 1,000 requests compares a busy machine with a quiet one.

targets.expr: (((sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0) - ((sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0))

(((sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0) - ((sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (preset)(increase(llm_inference_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])) + (((sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0) - ((sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0)), 1e-9)

1000 * (((sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0) - ((sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (preset)(increase(llm_inference_requests_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])), 1)

sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_estimated_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (preset)(increase(llm_savings_requests_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Net saved by proxy (USD, selected range)
panels.description: Each proxy prices with its own rate table, so compare these by tokens, not by money, when the tables differ.

targets.expr: (((sum by (proxy)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (proxy)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0) - ((sum by (proxy)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (proxy)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0))

panels.title: Net saved per 1,000 requests, by machine
panels.description: A fair comparison between a busy machine and a quiet one.

targets.expr: sort_desc(1000 * (((sum by (machine)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (machine)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0) - ((sum by (machine)(increase(llm_savings_added_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (machine)(increase(llm_savings_saved_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (machine)(increase(llm_inference_requests_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])), 1))
